text: I, um, I have a date with this girl from my work tonight.
She is very sexy, and, uh, I don't know, though.
I'm feeling guilty because of my girlfriend, Jocilyn.
Well, do you feel like you're betraying Jocilyn?
I mean, okay, we agreed from the beginning that it wasn't exclusive, right?
So I don't have any reason to be guilty at all, do I?
Well, I think that's for you to decide in your own mind and in your own heart.
But let me point out, however, Curtis, that guilt is a very, very destructive emotion.
